name: Netmend Slides
title: PDF, text or URL to PowerPoint with AI (free, in your browser)
desc: Turn a PDF, notes, a web page or just a topic into an editable PowerPoint (.pptx) deck in seconds. Free in your browser with your own Gemini key. No sign-up.
h1: Any PDF, text or link to an editable PowerPoint
intro: Drop a PDF, paste notes, give a web page or just type a topic. Netmend Slides writes the outline, picks layouts and gives you a real .pptx file you can edit in PowerPoint, Google Slides or Keynote.
